100:t_100:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is that guy with $$ネオ・ジオン$$ too!?」

100:t_100:3.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「I owe no answer to a man who is about to be defeated by me!」

100:t_101:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「All I need is to get my hands on the $$ユニコーン$$! $$バナージ・リンクス$$! I'll pay you back for everything up to now!」

100:t_101:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you fighting for something that small!?」

100:t_101:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「What do you know about me! Take the retribution for your insolence toward the Colonel with your own body!!」

100:t_102:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop fighting, $$ハマーン$$! This is no time for Earth and space to be at war!」

100:t_102:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Silence, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$! If the $$地球連邦$$ has no power to fight the $$新地球皇国$$, then $$ネオ・ジオン$$ will take the lead!」

100:t_102:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't let your potential rot, either! Come to my side!」

100:t_102:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What good is fighting over power now! Don't lose sight of what you have to do!」

100:t_102:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You get on my nerves at every turn! It seems we truly cannot get along!」

100:t_103:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$ラプラスの箱$$... Its existence could be a trump card.」

100:t_103:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「A power that changes the world... Even if there's such a thing now, what good is it...!」

100:t_103:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「It is precisely because it's now that we need that power. To guide this world!」

100:t_104:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ハマーン$$! You must have seen the light of people's hearts at $$アクシズ$$, too!」

100:t_104:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Back then, there was no Earth or space, and the hearts of people who hoped for the future became one!」

100:t_104:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Stop fighting, $$ハマーン$$! A war like this will only close off humanity's future!」

100:t_104:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Silence, $$アムロ・レイ$$. I cannot entrust humanity's future to an incompetent, powerless $$地球連邦$$.」

100:t_104:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I will unify humanity and stand against the threat! You, too, become part of that strength!」

100:t_104:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So you're the same as $$シャア$$ was back then!」

100:t_104:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't act on logic alone! Words like that can't move anyone!」

100:t_105:1.en:
$n
「Don't think I'll be an amateur forever...! I fought through the $$時獄戦役$$ too!」

100:t_105:2.en:
$n
「While I'm at it, let me tell you...! Until Earth is liberated, I don't intend to die, no matter who my opponent is!」

100:t_105:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then I'll teach you something too. Know your place...!」

100:t_106:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Don't push yourself, $$刹那$$. The $$ダブルオーライザー$$ can't fully bring out your power.」

100:t_106:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「That doesn't mean I can fall back. If we leave $$ネオ・ジオン$$ alone, the fighting will spread.」

100:t_106:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「If you understand that, it's fine.」

100:t_106:3.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I'll back you up...! Move as you see fit!」

100:t_106:4.en:
$$刹那$$
「Roger...! $$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$...! $$ダブルオーライザー$$, going in!」

100:t_107:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「Stop fighting...! You know as well that people can understand each other and become one at heart!」

100:t_107:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You're the same as $$カミーユ・ビダン$$...! You mistake understanding one another for barging into people's hearts uninvited!」

100:t_107:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「And you will learn this too! That we no longer have the luxury of waiting for Earth's humanity to mature!」

100:t_108:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「You stir up the enemy and I shoot them down... Not a bad combination.」

100:t_108:1.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「I'm counting on you, $$ロックオン$$...! $$マリー$$ and I will pin the enemy down!」

100:t_108:2.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Leave it to me! Anyone who can't see the state of the world gets shown the exit, pronto!」

100:t_109:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If we keep fighting $$ネオ・ジオン$$ like this, we can't stop the $$新地球皇国$$...!」

100:t_109:1.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「Roger! We'll hit $$ハマーン$$ and find out whatever we can about their intentions!」

100:t_109:3.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「All of $$トレミー$$'s systems are operating normally!」

100:t_109:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Commencing attack...! We'll go on the offensive now, too!」
